subject.input_summary: Independent static review of Replan R-CODEX-CACHE-1 and its command binding appendix against nine supplied criteria; baseline HEAD verified as 54ef203b4dd77e23564d0cba22f773346d30dfec. No execution success inferred from plan prose.

findings: FAIL C1: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:49 simultaneously freezes manifest bytes and requires new snapshot publication; exact stable command remains undefined.

UNKNOWN C2: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:49,56 does not specify digest serialization, deletion coverage, special-file handling or concurrent enumeration semantics sufficiently to establish complete integrity behavior.
FAIL C3: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:49,53 lacks an executable complete-reviewed-snapshot-to-installed-bytes binding; a second source scan alone does not authenticate review approval.

FAIL C4: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:49,59 lacks serialized commit, interrupted-install and rollback protocols. Baseline install-codex-source-guard.mjs:260-270 separates prior-manifest comparison from rename, allowing overlapping updates to pass the comparison before either publishes.
UNKNOWN C5: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:58 does not define Stop handling for helper, bootstrap or root-resolution failures. Baseline .codex/hooks.json:76 has an initial directory-failure exit before recovery.
UNKNOWN C6: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:49,60 states source-only/trust separation but does not freeze the helper CLI, exit contract or stable command grammar.
UNKNOWN C7: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:51,61 promises legacy/stable compatibility without defining stable equivalents of host-hook-ready.js:36-44,74-88 exact prefix, uniqueness and matcher checks.

FAIL C8: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:74-83 names executable test entrypoints but omits explicit deletion, concurrent installer, interrupted publication and rollback acceptance cases. Lines 71 and 86 correctly distinguish planned tests from executed evidence.
